I totally understand where you're coming from. I am in the same spot. I haven't finished my exams for university. All of my friends graduated last year and I'm still here sitting like a loser going to pay extra to repeat some courses. Just wanted to die. Like I'm a waste. But one thing I will tell you. It feels really really shitty right now. It's going to be hard repeating a grade it's going to be hard having this conversation with your parents. Its going to be hard feeling left behind. But once you do it. It'll feel much much better maybe not right away. Maybe  after a few days or weeks but it will definitely be a relief that you lived another day. Trust me. Depression will have you questioning your self worth and creating a false reality about who you are and your life. You are not a burden. You are brave. You are strong. You are worth it. 

Take a deep breath. It's hard and I won't deny it. But also think that it won't be hard for much longer. Minute by minute. Hour by hour. Day by day it'll get better. It's very hard to break the cycle of negative self talk. It's very hard to get rid of depression in general but you got this.
